intro: Finer time connectors: at once, at that moment, gradually, each time, and once something is done.
p.nada más.nota: Nada más llegar: as soon as I arrived.
p.al.nota: Al salir: on leaving, when I left.
b1.texto:
- at once: **en cuanto**, **tan pronto como**, **apenas** + clause; **nada más** + infinitive. **Nada más llegar**, me llamó.
- at that moment: **al** + infinitive. **Al entrar**, vi a Ana.
- gradually: **a medida que**, **conforme**. **A medida que** pasa el tiempo, lo entiendo mejor.
- each time: **cada vez que**, **siempre que**
- from, up to: **desde que**, **hasta que**
- once done: **una vez que** + clause; **una vez** + participle. **Una vez terminada** la reunión, nos fuimos.

The mood follows the rule of cuando. The future takes the subjunctive: **apenas llegues**, llámame. The past and habits take the indicative: **apenas llegó**, me llamó.

Later on: **a los dos días**, **al cabo de** un mes, dos años **después**.
b3.f0: As soon as I arrived at the office, I was introduced to the whole team.
b3.f1: On entering my office, I saw there was no computer.
b3.f2: As the hours went by, I felt calmer.
b3.f3: Every time I had a question, someone helped me.
b3.f4: Once the meeting was over, my boss talked to me about the program.
b3.f5: As soon as you have the computer, I'll explain it all to you.
b5.pregunta: Complete: as soon as I arrived, I called her.
b6.pregunta: Complete: on leaving, I saw Ana.
b6.o0.refuerzo: English on plus -ing is al plus infinitive.
b6.o2.refuerzo: A and el join: al salir.
b7.pregunta: Complete: as soon as you have it, call me.
b7.o0.refuerzo: It is in the future: subjunctive.
b7.o1.refuerzo: A future action takes the subjunctive.
b8.pregunta: Complete: as time goes by, I understand it better.
b8.o1.refuerzo: The subjunctive would look at the future only.
b8.o2.refuerzo: A medida que needs a conjugated verb.
b9.o0: Once the meeting was over, we left.
b9.o1: The meeting ended once and we left.
b9.o1.explicacion: Una vez plus participle means once it was done.
b9.o2: We left the meeting one time.
b9.o2.explicacion: Una vez plus participle means once it was done.
b10.traduccion: Every time I had a question, someone helped me.
b11.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write the story of an eventful arrival in a new city, using nada más, en cuanto, apenas, mientras, una vez que.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Tell aloud what you did, in order, on the first day of a job or a course.
